SEEMA NARAYAN VP Operations | Global / U.S. Stakeholder Management | Multi-City Operations | Client Account Management | Onboarding | KYC/AML | Operational Excellence

Bangalore / Hyderabad | Samynarayan1234@gmail.com | 9619856198 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/seema-narayan-b6b65a91

EXECUTIVE PROFILE Financial Services Operations & Transformation Leader with 23 years of experience across Banking, BFSI, Shared Services and GCC operations. Proven ability to lead 50+ teams and multi-city operations, manage U.S./global stakeholders, and deliver Client Account Management, onboarding, KYC/AML, account maintenance, risk & controls, workforce planning and operational governance. Track record of Lean Six Sigma and automation-led transformation, improving quality from 91.95% to 99.95% and automating workflows supporting 6,000+ monthly requests, while improving productivity, controls, service delivery and cost efficiency.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Financial Services Operations | Large LOB Leadership | Multi-City Operations | U.S./Global Stakeholder Management | Client Account Management (CAM) | Client Onboarding | KYC/AML | Account Maintenance | Data & Process Governance | Remediation & Exception Management | Operational Risk & Internal Controls | SLA/KPI/KRI Governance | Workforce & Capacity Planning | Budget & Cost Management | Vendor Management | Lean Six Sigma | Process Transformation | Automation | Quality Management | Business Resilience | Change Management | Talent Development | Employee Engagement | GCC Operations

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

WELLS FARGO INTERNATIONAL SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED | Vice President – Operations | 2021–2024 Financial Services / GCC Operations | Team size: 80+ | Multi-city operations

Led 80+ member cross-functional teams across multi-city operations, driving service delivery, productivity, quality, risk, workforce planning and performance governance.

Managed complex banking operations supporting global/U.S. stakeholders across onboarding, client servicing, workflow management and

business support; partnered with Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Operations.

Directed First Line KYC operations covering customer onboarding, risk profiling, compliance reviews, remediation and operational governance.

Built standardized operating models and CoAE/CoE practices to improve consistency, scalability, controls and service delivery.

Drove Lean Six Sigma, process standardization and automation, improving operational quality from 91.95% to 99.95%, reducing manual effort by 30% and automating 6,000+ monthly requests.

Led 5,600+ monthly customer reviews with 99.95% quality accuracy and zero customer-impacting escalations; established KPI dashboards, scorecards, productivity reporting and executive governance.

Led workforce/capacity planning, succession planning and employee development, reducing attrition by 15%; strengthened engagement through recognition and performance management.

Designed end-to-end quality governance, trend analysis and root-cause frameworks; improved decision-engine accuracy by 18% through cross-functional collaboration.

Supported business resiliency, operational controls and transition programs into India; delivered executive reporting and proactive issue/risk resolution.

PRIOR LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE ECOS (I) Mobility & Hospitality Pvt Ltd. — Area Head – Operations | 2018–2020 | Team: 90+ • Led multi-city customer support and operations; improved operational efficiency by 25%.

Managed enterprise stakeholders, SLAs/KPIs, customer issue resolution and continuous improvement; supported budgets, vendor management and people leadership.

Carzonrent India Private Limited — Branch Head – Operations | 2012–2018 | Team: 80 • Led end-to-end branch operations including service delivery, vendors, payroll and compliance.

Delivered 12% annual cost savings through vendor negotiations and developed high-performing teams, promoting 8 members into supervisory roles.

Aramex India Private Limited — Area Manager – Operations | 2010–2012 | Team: 100 • Managed international logistics as profit-center head; achieved 125% revenue growth and led proactive capacity planning.

ING Vysya Life Insurance Company — Territory Manager – Operations | 2007–2010 | Team: 80 • Oversaw claims, underwriting and servicing operations within SLA turnaround times; led cross-functional teams against service

benchmarks.

Mafatlal Systems Ltd. | Law Kim India Pvt. Ltd. | Infinity Solutions — Early Career | 2002–2007 • Managed multi-client processes for Citibank, Centurion Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, TATA-AIG, Bajaj Allianz and others; led teams up

to 40.

SELECTED IMPACT

99.95% Quality | Improved from 91.95% through quality governance and Lean Six Sigma. 6,000+ Monthly Requests | Automated high- volume workflows and reduced manual effort. 50+ / 80+ Leadership | Led large multi-city Financial Services/GCC teams. 25% Efficiency Gain | Delivered through process improvement. 12% Cost Savings | Achieved through vendor negotiations.

CERTIFICATIONS, EDUCATION & TECHNOLOGY Certifications: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt & Green Belt (2025) | PMP (2025) | KYC/AML Compliance Certification (2026)

Education: Bachelor’s Degree, Mumbai University (2010)

Technology: Tableau | Microsoft Office | Excel / Macros | Quality & Governance Dashboards | Process Improvement Tools | Basic Python Frameworks: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt | DMAIC | Operational Risk & Controls | Business Resilience | Continuous Improvement | Change Management.

Owned end-to-end Quality Transformation Program, driving process standardization, Lean Six Sigma improvements, governance and stakeholder alignment to achieve 99.95% quality.

Spearheaded high-priority transformation and process improvement initiatives, including Trust, Lockbox, and Back-Dated Request projects, over and above core responsibilities; delivered all initiatives ahead of schedule with 100% quality and adherence to governance standards.
